contracts.effective_date: per-phase lease commencement (9 phases; first expected NVDA FY2029)
contracts.instrument_type: residual value guaranty (multiple related guaranties; shared cap)
contracts.termination_right: yes: OpenAI satisfactory credit rating; LC/surety substitute; tenant termination; mutual pre-RFS abandonment
contracts.recourse_type: guarantee of shortfall vs guaranteed minimum value; landlord must concurrently pursue Tenant Parent Guaranty + tenant insurance
contracts.capacity_link: yes: 4.25 GW initial; covers defined portions of lease AND power payments
contracts.source_quality: filed 8-K + filed Ex-10.1 form of contract + 10-Q note
contracts.notes: Guarantees classified as credit derivatives; GMV covers data center power and transmission costs; payment conditional on ready-for-service; Guarantor Trigger = insolvency default or monetary default + landlord intent to terminate

instruments.trigger_or_contingency: Guarantor Trigger: tenant insolvency default or monetary default + landlord intent to terminate; payment conditional on ready-for-service; landlord must concurrently pursue Tenant Parent Guaranty + tenant insurance
instruments.notes: covers defined portions of lease AND power payments; recoveries under parent guaranty reduce cap dollar-for-dollar; site exclusively NVIDIA architecture >=20y
instruments.ladder_basis: signed August 2026 (after 7/26 period end; included in the filing's own guarantee table); 'each guarantee generally becomes effective upon commencement of the applicable lease' - first phase expected FY2029; effective exposure at period end ~0
instruments.clause_trigger: tenant insolvency default or monetary default, with the landlord entitled to and intending to terminate the lease
instruments.other_remedy: require the landlord to relet; allow the lease to be terminated; defer for up to a year
instruments.exclusivity: the premises deploy NVIDIA reference architecture exclusively for at least twenty years
instruments.carrying: not yet effective: each guaranty becomes effective when its lease commences (first phase FY2029)
instruments.clause_note: purchase and sublease are coded no because the remedy menu (A)-(E) of Section 12(a)(v) omits them; the relet option is the landlord's, at NVIDIA's election

evidence_rows.field: HL-0001 (shared cap across Related Guaranties; GMV composition) — line 22

evidence_rows.note: not verbatim, the coder's text: Options: Assumption / Relet / Sale / Rejection / Deferral (≤1 year, paying specified costs).; quote filled from the cited line

codebook_summaries.2.2_L3: Cumulative ladder adds support written for another party or asset value. It is not an expected-loss measure.
codebook_summaries.2.2_C2: Signed or subsequently agreed guarantee not yet effective: excluded from lower, included in gross and upper. Blank lower on this row is not a numerical zero observation.
codebook_summaries.2.3_wrong_way_flag: Payment occurs in states where the counterparty or shared sector is impaired; a qualitative coding flag, not an estimated probability or loss correlation.
codebook_summaries.2.3_circularity_flag: Coder labels a disclosed vendor-customer relationship; this is not proof of circular cash flows or a quantified risk estimate.
